note: Paths are relative to the project root. 'slides' lists every slide the asset is rendered on, including SVG <image> marks inside diagrams. Assets marked 'optimizedCopy' exist as a lighter derivative in assets/images/optimized/ so the original stays untouched.

speaker_portrait.subject: Dithered black-and-white studio portrait of Arron Kian Parejas on a black background

optimizedCopy.reason: Original is 1.39 MB and 4488x5608; the slide renders it at roughly 420x730 px.

speaker_portrait.notes: Black background, so it is framed as a sharp-cornered dark panel on the beige canvas. On slide 1 it is the tilted portrait at the back of the cover collage; on slide 2 it is the full-height portrait. object-position 50% 28% keeps the face in frame.

howtell_stage.subject: Arron Kian Parejas speaking with a microphone on stage at How & Tell Meetup 2

optimizedCopy.reason: The cover renders it at roughly 300x375 px; the 1280x720 derivative keeps the speaker sharp without shipping the full 1.53 MB original.

howtell_stage.notes: Used in the slide 1 cover collage. It is cropped to a 4:5 portrait window with object-position 68% 42% so the speaker fills the frame; the original is untouched.

appbuilders_group.subject: AppBuildersPH team on stage at How & Tell Meetup 2 holding trophies and event bags

optimizedCopy.reason: The cover renders it at roughly 540x304 px; the 1280x720 derivative is lighter while preserving the group and trophies.

appbuilders_group.notes: Front card of the slide 1 cover collage, tilted -2.5 degrees so every face and trophy stays visible. The original is untouched.

domodomo_appbuilders.subject: Collage: AppBuilders community leaderboard with DomoDomo ranked first, plus the DomoDomo website and event visuals
domodomo_appbuilders.notes: White source background, so it is shown on a white surface with object-fit: contain to keep the leaderboard readable.

bitpyre_hackathon.subject: AppCon 2024 Top 20 Teams: the BitPyre team of Holy Angel University on stage, inside a yellow event frame
bitpyre_hackathon.notes: The artwork already carries a yellow frame and event caption, so it is never cropped; the slide background matches the frame colour.

caffeine_hackathon.subject: Group on stage at the Caffeine hackathon holding first-place certificates

optimizedCopy.reason: Slightly smaller derivative used where the photo is rendered large.

skydev_hackathon.subject: SkyDev 'Automate the Future' hackathon group holding certificates, with the sponsor banner at the bottom

optimizedCopy.reason: Original is 619 KB; the derivative is 37% lighter at the rendered size.

helios_huggingface.subject: Helios open-weight foundation model page on Hugging Face (dark theme), showing LiteRT and ONNX tags and 2,256 downloads last month
helios_huggingface.notes: Rendered inside a dark frame on slides 2 and 9 so the dark UI capture shows no white letterboxing. Slide 10 references its LiteRT tag in text only.

gemini_title_card.subject: Title card reading 'Gemini 4 Argon — Google Cloud' with the Gemini sparkle, on black
gemini_title_card.notes: Shown exactly as supplied in a sharp black frame as the Gemini context panel on slide 9. No claim is made in the talk about the product name shown in the image.

flutter_logo.subject: Flutter logo — blue chevron mark plus wordmark on a transparent background
flutter_logo.notes: On slides 7 and 10 the mark is cropped from the wordmark with a nested SVG viewBox (crop 4,4,214,264) so the mark and the row label never overlap. On slide 8 the full lockup is shown.

firebase_logo.subject: Firebase logo — flame mark above the 'Firebase' wordmark on white
firebase_logo.notes: On slide 7 the flame is cropped with a nested SVG viewBox (crop 211,117,219,273) and paired with a text label. On slide 8 the square white artwork is blended with mix-blend-mode: multiply so it sits on the paper without a visible tile.

ml_kit_logo.subject: Google ML Kit logo — blue 'M' glyph plus wordmark on a transparent background
ml_kit_logo.notes: On slides 7 and 10 the 'M' glyph is cropped with a nested SVG viewBox (crop 0,54,496,360) and paired with a text label. On slide 8 the full lockup is shown.

google_cloud_logo.subject: Google Cloud logo — multicolor cloud above the 'Google Cloud' wordmark on white
google_cloud_logo.notes: Lowest-resolution source in the set (225x225). It is rendered small on slide 8, blended with mix-blend-mode: multiply, and its cloud mark is cropped with a nested SVG viewBox (crop 52,41,121,98) on slide 7.

contact_qr.subject: QR code with white modules on a dark navy background
contact_qr.notes: Decoded during QA: it resolves to https://www.linkedin.com/in/arron-parejas/ . That URL is also written out as a text link beside the QR so the contact details work even if the code is not scanned. Shown at 92 px beside the larger handbook QR.

handbook_qr.subject: Panda-illustrated QR code linking to the Free Developer Stack Handbook
handbook_qr.notes: Decoded during QA: it resolves to https://docs.google.com/document/d/1hxBY6auIP5fya0ir9FhvKsGnrCcVYjRnaIrMpx8I9Nw/edit?usp=sharing . The document title was verified as 'Free Developer Stack Handbook'. Shown at the same 92 px size as the socials QR, with a text link beneath it, and also linked from slide 8's docs row.
